result.title: Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs
result.summary: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统评测十种视觉 token 剪枝方法在三个 MLLM 家族、五类能力上的表现，指出通用 VQA 高分常以 OCR、visual grounding 等细粒度任务的大幅退化为代价，并提出免训练的两阶段混合粒度剪枝方法 Bifocal，分别分配 query 相关与图像内在证据预算并加入池化粗表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系「视觉证据筛选」与内部状态是否保留任务必要细粒度细节：其失败诊断（单一重要性排序忽略任务互补证据、稀疏 patch 破坏空间完整性）可供核查视觉旁路与信息坍缩对推理任务的影响，混合粒度预算设计也可能提供视觉证据留存的对照思路。
